title: Surreal Alphabet Owl
description: A large white owl with outstretched wings sits centrally, its body formed from the word 'LIGHT' while 'E' and 'N' appear above its head with hanging lanterns. An open antique book, inkwell, and scattered letters float in a dreamlike sunset sky with antlered branches and a distant orange sun.
prompt: Surreal fantasy painting of a majestic white owl with large feathered wings, its body composed of the word LIGHT in ornate letters, with the letters E and N floating above its head decorated with hanging lanterns and antlers dripping honey. An open old book with visible text and an inkwell sit on a stone ledge in the foreground as numerous alphabet letters, crescent moons, and small objects float through a vibrant sunset sky with purple, orange and green clouds and a glowing sun on the horizon.
